processing.resampling: Mean of 4x4 blocks of 0.05 degree pixels to a 0.2 degree grid. Fill value (-3000) and values outside -2000..10000 were removed before averaging. A 0.2 degree cell was kept only if at least 8 of its 16 source pixels were valid.
processing.quality_filter: Pixel reliability layer: only codes 0 (good) and 1 (marginal) kept. Codes -1 (fill), 2 (snow/ice), 3 (cloudy) and 4 (estimated from the historical record) excluded.
